hello: What would you like to know?
helloHint: Ask about money, budgets, goals, tasks or your documents, in English or Bangla. Answers come from your books, with the sources shown.
prompt1: How much money do we have across all accounts?
prompt2: What was our profit last month?
prompt3: Which budgets are close to their limit?
prompt4: Remind me to call the landlord about the lease on Monday
footnote: The assistant can make mistakes. It never changes anything until you confirm a card.
noAccess: The assistant isn’t available to you here
noAccessHint: Ask an owner or admin to give your role the “Use the AI assistant” permission.
notConfigured: The AI assistant isn’t switched on
notConfiguredHint: Whoever runs this server needs to add an AI provider key. Everything else in Business OS works without it.
guard_corrected: A figure in this answer was checked against your books and corrected.
guard_fallback: The answer couldn’t be checked against your books, so only the figures are shown.
guard_blocked: This answer was held back because its figures didn’t match your books.
postNow: Post it to the books now
planTitle: The AI assistant comes with Pro
planBody: Ask about your money, budgets and documents in English or Bangla, and let it draft tasks and transactions for you to confirm.
pausedHint: It's switched off for everyone for a short while. Your conversations are safe; please try again later.
